clue.text: Man over the side

parts.note: reads like someone fallen overboard, but means the person placed in charge of a team or a ship's crew

explanation.surface: A cry of alarm as someone tumbles overboard from a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' is in the sense of 'in charge of', and a side is a sports team; the nautical surface hides the captain of a team.
explanation.definitionFit: A captain of a team or vessel is the one set above, or in charge of, that side.

clue.text: Name address down NE gales blowing round the country

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Name address down NE gales blowing round the country (7)', has three words ('Name address down') that play no part in the anagram of NE GALES; the text looks garbled by OCR and no scan is available.
annotationWithheld.clue: Name address down NE gales blowing round the country

clue.text: Where his school friends might be as good as he is

definitions.text: Where his school friends might be as good as he is

parts.words: Where his school friends might be as good as he is
parts.note: a school form is a group of pupils, and the phrase also means of equal standing

explanation.surface: A thought about a pupil whose classmates match him in ability.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase means both 'in the same form at school' and 'of equal quality'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being of equal merit is idiomatically being in one grade with someone, literally the same school form.

clue.text: Part of ship unaffected by capsizing

indicators.note: capsizing turns a thing upside down, so in a down clue the letters read the same either way

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A section of a vessel that stays intact when the boat overturns.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'capsizing' means reading from the bottom up; the word reads the same.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised deck at the stern of an old sailing vessel bears this name.

clue.text: Cooker for fowl on a hot day

definitions.meaning: an oven or pan used for cooking poultry

explanation.definitionFit: A pan or oven for cooking chickens, and colloquially a sweltering day.

clue.text: For instance a revolutionary leader returns in a fit of violent anger

indicators.note: returns tells us the whole string of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: for instance is abbreviated e.g.

indicators.note: a leader is the front of something, so this takes the opening letter of revolutionary

explanation.surface: A rebel chief comes back home in a furious temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Fury is a sudden fit of violent anger.

clue.text: Save about 100 too many

parts.note: re means about or concerning
C is the Roman numeral for 100
over means in excess

explanation.surface: Keep roughly a hundred because there are more than needed.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrieve or rescue something is to get it back safely.

clue.text: Cut talk by quarter of an hour

parts.note: gas is informal for idle chatter

indicators.note: a quarter of a four-letter word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Shortening a speech by fifteen minutes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarter of an hour' is not fifteen minutes but one letter of the four in HOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep wound or slash is a cut.

clue.text: Work in the theatre?

parts.note: the theatre is the operating theatre, where surgeons work, not a stage

explanation.surface: A question about having a job on the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' suggests acting; it is a hospital's operating theatre, where a surgeon carries out procedures.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons perform procedures on patients in an operating theatre.

clue.text: Quiz chairman to interrogate teacher

parts.note: to interrogate is to question someone closely
a master is a schoolteacher

explanation.surface: The host of a quiz is going to grill a schoolteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: The person presiding over a quiz poses the questions to contestants.

clue.text: It is designed to cover a race

definitions.text: It is designed to cover a race

parts.words: It is designed to cover a race
parts.note: race here means a people or nation, not a contest, and the covering is traditional dress

explanation.surface: Sounds like something made to protect a running track or racecourse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Race' suggests a sporting event, but it is a people; the garment is the traditional dress of a country.
explanation.definitionFit: Traditional dress is clothing designed for, and worn by, a whole people.

clue.text: Turns and leaves

definitions.meaning: turns as in a player's ... in a game

explanation.definitionFit: Plural of a player's turn in a game, and the verb meaning departs.

clue.text: Do most ovens have one in-cluded?

definitions.text: Do most ovens have one in-cluded?

indicators.note: the hyphen splits 'included' so it signals letters held within the words most ovens

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about whether ovens generally come with a cooker built in.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'moST OVEns'; the whole clue doubles as a definition, since ovens are usually part of a cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: Most kitchen ovens are housed in a cooker, so the cooker is the one included.

clue.text: Large area is about to be taken in by motoring organisation

indicators.note: taken in by means held inside the letters for the motoring organisation

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring organisation

indicators.note: about here says the word is should be turned back to front

explanation.surface: A big region is going to be absorbed by a breakdown-recovery club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns IS into SI, which 'taken in by' puts inside AA.
explanation.definitionFit: A continent is about as large an area of land as there is.

clue.text: He in strange surroundings is cold

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside the word for strange, its surroundings

parts.note: rum is informal British for odd or strange

explanation.surface: A man feels chilly in unfamiliar settings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in strange surroundings' puts HE inside RUM; 'cold' is the illness, not a temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: Watery discharge from the nose and eyes, as with a head cold, is the old word here.

clue.text: Just having the necessary ability

definitions.meaning: fair, even-handed, as in fair treatment
as in being up to a task

explanation.definitionFit: Fair and even-handed in treatment, and also up to a task, capable of it.

clue.text: Edward conceals the hide

indicators.note: conceals means one piece hides the other inside it

parts.note: Edward Lear, the Victorian nonsense poet

explanation.surface: A man named Edward keeps an animal skin out of sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Edward' is not ED but the nonsense poet Edward Lear; 'conceals' puts THE inside LEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Tanned animal skin, a hide, is the material used for shoes and saddles.

clue.text: Order engineers some writing paper

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Army sappers place a request for stationery.
explanation.definitionFit: To demand or order something is to make it obligatory, as in 'the rules oblige you'.

clue.text: Female or male animal? It's male

parts.note: roe is the egg mass of a female fish, so it stands for the female
a buck is the male of deer, rabbits and similar animals

explanation.surface: A riddle: is this creature a she or a he? It is a he.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Female or male animal?' looks like a question about one creature; it is two pieces, and 'It's male' defines the stag of a small deer species.
explanation.definitionFit: The male of the small European roe deer species is called by this name.

clue.text: Come back with a new cover

definitions.meaning: said of a book given a fresh binding

explanation.definitionFit: To bounce back after a setback, and of a book, given fresh binding.

clue.text: Aware of the monarch about this time

indicators.note: about means the word for monarch goes round the other piece

parts.note: a king is a monarch
now means at this time

explanation.surface: Conscious of the sovereign at the present moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shrewd and well informed is being aware of what is going on.

clue.text: Stop being loyal

definitions.meaning: as in stopping the flow of blood from a wound
steadfast and faithful to a cause

explanation.definitionFit: A verb meaning to stem a flow such as bleeding, and an adjective meaning steadfast.

clue.text: Dash to pieces with wild threats

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder, so the letters of threats are thrown about

explanation.surface: Smashing something up while making violent threats.
explanation.definitionFit: To smash into fragments is to dash something to pieces.

clue.text: Intoxicated for period of festival

parts.note: high means drunk or drugged
a day is a period of time

explanation.surface: Drunk throughout the time of a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: A feast or holy day is a festival occasion; the phrase pairs with holiday.

clue.text: It emits light in the garden

definitions.text: It emits light in the garden

parts.words: It emits light in the garden
parts.note: two senses: the glass part of a lamp gives light, and a planted onion-like root grows in a flower bed

explanation.surface: Something that glows among the flower beds, like a garden lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: The glass part of an electric lamp gives off light; a daffodil's swollen root is planted in beds.

clue.text: Back-biter

parts.note: not a slanderer but a tooth at the back of the mouth that does the biting

explanation.surface: Someone who speaks ill of others behind their back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back-biter' normally means a slanderer; read literally it is a grinding tooth at the back of the jaw.
explanation.definitionFit: Grinding teeth sit at the back of the jaw and do the chewing.

clue.text: Fringe report

definitions.meaning: hair cut straight across the forehead, called this in American English

explanation.definitionFit: The American word for hair cut across the forehead, and a loud explosive noise.

clue.text: Repel most of the stimulus

indicators.note: most of means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: to spurn is to reject or rebuff

explanation.surface: Pushing away nearly all of the encouragement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims the last letter from SPURN.
explanation.definitionFit: An incentive or goad urging someone on is a stimulus.

clue.text: It is not the cream that comes to the top

definitions.text: It is not the cream that comes to the top

parts.words: It is not the cream that comes to the top
parts.note: cream rises to the top of milk, but so does the froth of impurities on a liquid

explanation.surface: Not everything that rises is the best of the bunch.
explanation.walkthrough: Plays on 'the cream rises to the top': the other thing that rises is the dirty froth, also a word for worthless people.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating froth of impurities on a liquid, and figuratively the dregs of society.

clue.text: Not chastised, up I struggled being naive

indicators.note: struggled suggests the letters wriggling into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone who was never punished floundered about because they were green and inexperienced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struggled' rearranges the fifteen letters of NOT CHASTISED UP I.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking worldly experience means being innocent, credulous and simple.

clue.text: Father to go back for a jumper

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title

indicators.note: back says the word go is to be written in reverse

explanation.surface: A priest has to return because he left his sweater behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns GO into OG. 'jumper' is not a sweater but an animal that leaps.
explanation.definitionFit: A leaping amphibian is a natural jumper.

clue.text: Take another partner for better or for worse

definitions.text: Take another partner for better or for worse

parts.words: Take another partner for better or for worse
parts.note: the second phrase quotes the wedding vows, so the new partner is a spouse taken in a second ceremony

explanation.surface: Finding someone new, whether it turns out well or badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For better or for worse' reads as a shrug about the outcome but is the wording of the marriage vows.
explanation.definitionFit: Wedding a second time means making the marriage vows again with a new spouse.
